key_insight: Vero provides a fully open reinforcement-learning training recipe that produces vision–language models matching or exceeding other open-weight models on diverse visual reasoning tasks, demonstrating that strong, general visual reasoning can be achieved without proprietary pipelines or data.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the lack of transparent, reproducible RL pipelines and non-public training data that have blocked the community from building competitive, general-purpose visual reasoners.
method: Design and release an end-to-end, open RL recipe for fine-tuning VLMs to improve visual reasoning and alignment.
Scale training across diverse visual reasoning domains (charts, science, spatial, open-ended tasks) using publicly available datasets and carefully constructed task mixes.
Provide benchmark-driven evaluation and open checkpoints/tools so results are reproducible and comparable to proprietary baselines.
impact: This work democratizes high-performance visual reasoning by giving practitioners a reproducible RL-based path to build and adapt competitive VLMs across many domains, accelerating research, deployment, and safe alignment work.

paper_title: Vero: An Open RL Recipe for General Visual Reasoning
